title: Overpriced and Not High Quality
text:
Overpriced and Not High Quality. Note: There are two models attached to this listing. I am specifically reviewing model 0917.

I will state outright that I do not like electric blankets, after I had one that decided to short out noisily while in use. This is the first electric blanket I have had in many years, and I have some criticisms of it, outside my distrust.

This is not a large blanket at all, but instead seems to be more of a throw size suitable for curling up in a chair or on the couch in front of the television. That’s fine, there’s a use for something like that and if that’s the intended use it’ll be fine. If you want it for a double, queen or king-sized bed, it won’t cover the whole bed, and even that can be ok if you just want coverage for one.

The controls are very straightforward and easy. Power it on, and set the temperature between 1 and 5. It doesn’t require reading a manual or watching a video - the controls are just simple, and that’s the way they should be. Now, that said, it just doesn’t get all that warm. It’s fine for getting the chill off, but if you’re looking for a blanket that will warm you to the core, this one isn’t it. So far the controls haven’t failed, but there have been enough complaints from other reviewers that I’m concerned about the longevity of this blanket.

The blanket itself isn’t great. This blanket resembles a bath throw rug, which is plush and has long strands on the fluffy side. That’s ok, except that this particular blanket sheds. It shed enough that it leaves fluff on your clothes and on whatever furniture on which you’re sitting.

I can’t recommend this blanket. It’s ok, but it lacks the quality at the price point.

When your aching body feels like it could use some soothing, relief is simply one electrical outlet away. Plug in and switch on your Serta Faux Fur Throw and within minutes you'll be experiencing not only the therapeutic benefits of radiating heat, but also the luxurious feeling of faux fur. The easy to use controller has 4 heat settings, allowing you to customize your comfort level. You'll be so relaxed, there's a high likelihood that you'll doze off. And we thought of that, too.
